title: [finding] the packaged-base refusal for a packaged `action` or `permission` (ADR-0126 Regime C) still prescribes "edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE", not the sanctioned path; a packaged action's DELETE names no path at all
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `refusePackagedBaseOverride` / `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`. PR #20909 (#20819) gives them one per-regime table, `PACKAGED_BASE_REGIME` / `PACKAGED_BASE_REFUSAL_BY_REGIME`. Finding class **(b)**, a violated declared contract. The release-text exception also applies: the sentence ships in every refusal.

`reach:` measured by #20819's dev (`os-dev-report` 5916420712, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) at PR #20909's head. The dev drove the real REST `/meta` route handler in-process, over a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` with a registry double and an environment kernel.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01DEvba2nBuD4tWzfq8r8NFY`, `os-support-ai`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

| request | answer |
|:--|:--|
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/pkg_approve` (a packaged action) | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`: "Edit the source artifact and redeploy, or set OS_METADATA_WRITABLE to grant a runtime escape hatch. See docs/adr/0005-…" |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/pkg_perm` (a packaged permission set) | the same sentence |
| `DELETE` on the packaged action | a refusal that names **no** path |

## The contract it violates

- ADR-0126 §3 puts `permission` and `action` (its disable half) in **Regime C**, with `flow`.
- ADR-0126 §2 requires the Regime C refusal to name the sanctioned path. Triage's direction on #20819 (5908835963) says the prescription comes "from one table keyed on the type's regime".
- PR #20909 declares only `flow: 'C'`, because its Regime C sentence names the `/automation` clone and toggle routes. Those are not these types' paths:
  - `action`: the activation switch, `POST /api/v1/actions/_activation/:object/:action`, with no clone chartered;
  - `permission`: its own clone.
  So each needs its own row, or the table needs a per-type path under one regime.

## Scope for whoever takes it (⛔ not a ruling)

- Declare `action` and `permission` in the regime table, and give each a sentence naming its own sanctioned path. Cite ADR-0126, and ⛔ don't name `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`.
- Settle the table's shape first: a Regime C sentence parameterised by the type's sanctioned routes, or one row per type. ⛔ No type special case in the door's prose.
- ⛔ Not the hatch's fate, nor the other regimes' sentences: that is #15206's (ADR-0131 D6/D7/D13).
- Pins: `PUT` / `DELETE` on a packaged action and a packaged permission set name their sanctioned path, with no `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`; flow's #20819 sentence byte-identical.
- Serial: after PR #20909.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed, in the act that filed this card:
- 「Regime C action permission packaged refusal NOT_OVERRIDABLE OS_METADATA_WRITABLE sanctioned path escape hatch」: 7 hits. #20819 (open) is the flow half, delivered by PR #20909. #19874, #17936, #8013, #4463, #3715 and #9957 (closed) are other permission and refusal texts. None covers action or permission at the packaged-base door.

Dedupe words: `Regime C action refusal sanctioned path` · `packaged action NOT_OVERRIDABLE escape hatch` · `permission set refusal OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` · `packaged base regime table`
